messages.subject: Beginner needs help
parts:
Hi, I'm trying my hands on INLA for the fist time. I tried practicing these lines of codes, but I got an error below
> data <- read.csv(file.choose())
> ########################################################################################
> library(INLA)
> library(spdep)
> library(maptools)
> Ohio.adj = system.file("Ohio_data/Ohio.graph", package="INLA")
> formula.par<- y~1 + f(county, model="bym", graph=Ohio.adj, constr=TRUE) + f(county1, year, model="iid",constr=TRUE) + year
> model.par <- inla(formula.par,family="poisson",data=data,E=E, 
+                   control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), 
+                   control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))
Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
>
please what  is wrong?
Thanks

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Beginner needs help
parts:
There is no Ohio graph in the package, and you have to provide it
manually.
